claims.statement: Monitoring uses the canonical missions model; the experimental monitoringJobs model is not registered.
Workbench endpoints are read-only semantic projections of canonical runtime records and do not create a parallel scheduler or data model.
The application opens on one compact role-aware Home with one contextual primary action, visible reason and effect, and secondary role context available progressively.
The bootstrap response projects a canonical server-issued access profile describing identity, capabilities, prohibited actions, state effects and evidence.
A read-only role-aware support surface explains architecture, journeys, terminology, benchmark mappings, runtime proof and limitations while presenting summary before full detail.
The final cascade resolves legacy visual aliases onto canonical tokens and provides explicit focus, target, reflow, reduced-motion and forced-colors baselines.
Administration presents posture first and moves usage, governance and directory detail into independent disclosures without adding a new write workflow.
Auditor access remains read-only and exposes evidence through the active auditor identity.
The repository contains an executable 18-dimension enterprise assurance model.
The ICTC 1.4 experience model remains a regression contract.
The 1.6 model remains a regression model with M+100 and N+100 zero novelty.
ICTC 1.7 uses one deterministic surface router, one primary action per surface context, summary-first pages, progressive internal detail, canonical HTML labels and M+100 no-novelty assurance.
Deployment certification requires external identity, TLS, storage, backup, malware scanning, observability and accessibility evidence.
